search_products_by_name: search the shopping catalog for products matching a name substring case-insensitively
add_to_cart_and_checkout: add items to the shopping cart and checkout with an optional discount code
manage_order_lifecycle: create an order via checkout then cancel it or update its status to shipped
update_item_price_and_availability: update an existing product variant price or toggle its availability flag
add_product_and_variant: add a new product to the catalog then add a priced variant with options
